title: FIFA World Cup complete historical match ledger
scope: Every played match in the men's FIFA World Cup from 1930 through 2026 and the women's FIFA World Cup from 1991 through 2023.

completenessNotes: This file is a match-level results ledger. It is not a complete player appearance, lineup, substitution, referee, attendance, or event-by-event scorer database.
Venue and time are null where the source did not supply a normalized field. Names, scores, stages, groups, dates, extra-time flags, and penalty shootout scores are retained when present.

For the 2023 women's tournament, the match ledger was assembled from eight group pages and the knockout-stage page; local kickoff times, venues, and cities were not captured in this consolidated supplement.
The 2026 men's tournament match list includes 104 matches from OpenFootball.
